<thought>From the generated fragment list, the two neutral‑looking fragments that together can account for the aromatic ring with chlorine and the carbonyl/ester portion of the target molecule are:

1. CCOC(=O)c1ccc(Nc2cc[c-]nc2)cc1  
2. O=C([O-])c1ccc(Nc2ccc(Cl)nc2)cc1  

These fragments share a common aniline‑type linkage (Nc…) and can be joined at the nitrogen to reconstruct a molecule consistent with the given formula, DBE, aromatic carbon count, and presence of chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['CCOC(=O)c1ccc(Nc2cc[c-]nc2)cc1', 'O=C([O-])c1ccc(Nc2ccc(Cl)nc2)cc1']</final_answer>
